title: Trait Hoarder
altTitles: Warrior Kim Builds up His Characteristics
ノーマルキャラな俺、特性を集めて無双する
description: Kim Joonsoo is a free-to-play ranker in the mobile game Arcane Seoul. After finally obtaining one of the game's strongest characters, the Heavenly Demon, he is suddenly transported into the game as Warrior Kim, a basic tutorial character. Fortunately, Warrior Kim possesses the unique ability to swap and accumulate traits indefinitely. Armed with his extensive game knowledge and this unusual ability, Joonsoo must survive the brutal world of Arcane Seoul and grow from an ordinary tutorial character into an overwhelming warrior.
author: Lico / San Hocho
